reports.title: CALLAWAY GOLF COMPANY ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

guidance.heading: 2026 OUTLOOK
section: Given the strength of the Company’s third quarter results and improved outlook, the Company increased its full-year net sales and Adjusted EBITDA guidance. Although the Company’s Q4 results are still expected to be down year over year due to the previously disclosed strategic shift in launch timing, rationalization of lower margin business, investments in fitting, and less dividend income due to the use of cash to pay off over $1.4 billion of debt during the first half of 2026, the Company now expects revenue to grow for the full year and a significant improvement in full year Adjusted EBITDA.
